references.name: legacy-main-terminal-2017
references.author: Arunvrparavur
references.observed: January2017 main frontage: two-storey cream/yellow block, orange-red tiled roof/awnings and orange fascia bands, olive pilasters, brown window louvres/frames, projecting columned porch, low stairs/ramp and roof water tank. This is dated legacy evidence; its survival in2026 is unverified. No copied lettering, advertising, railway emblems or people.

references.author: Express
references.license: Ordinary visual reference only; not redistributed or used as texture
references.observed: July2026 construction bridge: unfinished broad steel pedestrian deck, concrete/Y brackets, pale curved roof ribs without finished panels, stairs/lift towers and low distant platform canopies. Does not verify old main-front survival. Used only to flag redevelopment uncertainty; no construction-stage or speculative finished geometry included.
